更新历史将测试版标识移入标题；桌面服务状态改为不可点击、不可选中的静态指示。: Moved the test-build label into release headings and made desktop service status a static indicator.

每种效果分别映射图形；两张 1500×1500 透明图标集按 300×300 网: Each effect has its own graphic. Two shared 1500 × 1500 transparent sheets provide 300 × 300 icons.

保留窗口大背景与品牌底纹、容器凹槽边框和渐变底色，沿用现有参数编辑与页面操作。: Preserved the window and brand backgrounds, recessed borders, gradients and editing behavior.
效果参数在拖动时实时预览，松手或短暂停顿后合并保存，减少连续写盘和重复界面刷新。: Effects preview continuously while dragging. Saves are combined on release or after a short pause.
减少鼠标悬停与焦点描边的重复计算，共用原生动画时钟，保留现有交互配色与动效开关。: Reduced repeated hover and focus calculations and shared native animation timing.
素材封面按需加载并复用缓存，替换封面仅刷新对应条目，保留当前选择与滚动位置。: Covers load on demand and reuse the cache. Replacing a cover refreshes its entry and preserves selection and scroll.

沿用现有圆角、凹槽材质、字体和交互反馈，保留层级输入、显示与锁定操作，以及数值框: Retained rounded recessed controls, fonts, feedback, layer input, visibility, locking and double-click editing.
显示指标直接复用配置分享的深色圆角卡片：左侧图标、中间名称、右侧勾选，选中颜色集: Metrics use dark rounded cards with an icon, name and checkmark. Selection color is concentrated on the checkmark.
卡片按内容宽度自动换行，统一 16 DIP 间距，并限制单卡宽度，减少原有小胶囊: Cards wrap to the available width with 16 DIP gaps and a maximum width.
排序预览使用同一凹槽材质、字体与圆角，保持紧凑卡片宽度；右侧序号标记选中项，前移: The order preview uses matching compact cards. The numbered marker shows selection and move buttons follow the preview width.

显示指标按可用宽度切换为四列、两列或单列，减少空白，沿用统一圆角勾选样式。: Metrics use one, two or four columns depending on available width.
数值框默认使用独立拖动面，悬停和单击不会进入文字输入；双击全选编辑，保留回车确认: Drag numeric fields by default. Double-click to select and type, Enter to confirm and Esc to cancel.
指标排列改为布局设置和可拖动顺序预览，网格列数可拖动、双击输入或加减调整；窄窗口: Layout controls include a draggable order preview and adjustable column count. Controls stack on narrow windows.
预览仅显示已启用指标，保留排列顺序、列数、保存与撤销；控件继续使用公共胶囊按钮、: The preview shows enabled metrics and preserves order, columns, saving and undo with shared control styling.

任务栏辅助程序恢复为仅隐藏和恢复任务栏，不修改系统工作区或其他应用的窗口尺寸。: The helper only hides and restores the taskbar. It no longer changes the work area or resizes other apps.

沿用整体 UI、更新历史排版、效果保存与其他功能。: Preserved release note layout, effect saving and other controls.

组标题显示已选数量，全选与清空分开操作；全选跳过不可导出的效果。: Category titles show selection counts. Select all and Clear are separate, and Select all skips nonexportable effects.
保留原有导出选项、默认值、配置保存及分享协议。: Export options, defaults, saved settings and the sharing protocol are preserved.

移除组件列表底部常驻操作提示，运行异常继续通过错误提示显示。: Removed the permanent widget list hint. Runtime problems still appear as errors.
分享中的效果、组件及隐私选项改为小圆角矩形，保留原有选中样式和操作；延续数值直接: Sharing options use compact rounded rectangles. Direct numeric input, pinned Add actions and auto-hiding scrollbars are retained.
效果、粒子、组件、颜色与播放参数的数值框支持单击直接输入，首次进入全选，保留复制: Numeric fields support direct input, initial select-all, paste and Tab navigation.
按参数区分整数、小数、负数和动态范围；回车确认，离开输入框提交，Esc 取消；错: Validation respects type, precision, sign and dynamic range. Enter or focus loss commits. Esc cancels. Invalid entries show the allowed range.
输入过程中不改变参数，确认后一次应用和保存；滑杆仍实时生效，组件位置和层级可拖动: Typed values apply and save once on commit. Sliders update live and widget position and layer labels can be dragged.

固定添加入口与滚动条自动隐藏: Pinned Add actions and auto-hiding scrollbars

保留统一控件样式、焦点反馈和对象选择逻辑，适配窄窗口与文字放大。: Standard styles, focus feedback and target behavior support narrow windows and larger text.

所有滑杆取消外围悬浮与焦点高亮框，保留轨道、滑块和数值调节。: Removed outer hover and focus borders from sliders while retaining tracks, handles and value input.

布置展示台改为居中弹窗，沿用软件统一控件，支持保存和取消。: Shelf arrangement opens in a centered dialog with Save and Cancel.
默认摆件改为二次元手办与磁带小道具，保留透明 PNG 更换、位置、大小、翻转和自: Default decorations are illustrated figures and small cassettes. Transparent PNGs, positioning, scaling, flipping and reflections are supported.

屏幕和素材效果按作用对象刷新，保留其他对象的设置与显示状态。: Screen and media effects refresh only the active target while preserving other targets.

合并组件的连续更新并限制待发送指令与临时撤销记录，避免宿主无响应时持续积压。: Coalesced widget updates and bounded queued commands and undo records when the host stops responding.

鼠标离开按钮后亮光缓慢往返，移入时平滑切回鼠标跟随。: The highlight drifts when idle and follows the pointer smoothly on hover.

主导航文字和图标放大 20%，保留原侧栏和按钮宽度，只增加按钮高度；系统文字继续: Enlarged navigation labels and icons by 20%. Fixed widths are preserved, with more height for wrapped text.

调整银面边缘高光、细颗粒、文字底纹明暗层次和右侧渐隐波点、喷溅细节；保留宽竖光跟: Refined edge highlights, grain, lettering and fading dots while keeping the pointer-following reflection.
添加组件、添加效果采用独立的近白亮银按钮，保留粗橙色加号、文字底纹、细颗粒与渐隐: Add widget and Add effect use near-white silver, an orange plus, background lettering, fine grain and fading dots.
宽幅竖向反光带随鼠标横向移动，轮廓带轻微弯曲和倾斜；文字、加号和材质颗粒保持稳定: A broad curved reflection follows horizontal pointer movement. Text, plus and grain remain still.
两个添加入口使用独立的按压与键盘焦点样式，沿用原有添加弹窗和焦点返回。: The two Add actions use independent press and keyboard focus styles with existing dialogs and focus return.
按钮随可用宽度自适应，窄尺寸收起文字底纹；关闭界面动效或系统动画后保留静态银面，: Buttons adapt to width and drop decorative lettering when narrow. Disabling motion keeps a static face and inactive windows stop tracking the pointer.
修复首包启动时 DisplayFont 资源查找失败，以及桌面窗口的系统主题通知: Fixed missing DisplayFont on first startup and failures subscribing to desktop theme changes.
主导航采用 VHS 磁带外壳、复古标签、压纹与四角大十字螺丝。: Added a VHS-style navigation shell with a label, embossed details and corner screws.
未选中按钮使用淡化的超粗扁宽数字底纹，选中项隐藏底纹并沿用统一黄绿色反馈。: Inactive buttons show faint wide numerals. The selected item hides the numeral and uses the shared accent.
侧栏根据窗口宽度在 224、200、80 DIP 三档切换；窄栏可展开完整导航。: The sidebar switches between 224, 200 and 80 DIP. The narrow sidebar can expand.
高度不足时先收起装饰区，再让导航独立滚动；撤销、重做保持纯图标，服务状态始终可访: Short windows collapse decoration first, then scroll navigation separately. Undo, Redo and service status stay accessible.
播放队列、添加效果、作用对象和组件弹窗的外层遮罩不再显示悬停或焦点描边，点击空白: Queue, effect, target and widget overlays no longer show hover or focus borders. Click outside to dismiss.
素材卡片选中改为黄绿色呼吸描边，保留原底色、文字颜色与勾选标记。: Selected media cards use a pulsing accent border and retain their background, text and checkmark.
配置分享中的效果和组件勾选项使用专用描边选中样式，不再填充整行底色。: Sharing checkboxes for effects and widgets highlight the outline instead of filling the row.
其他按钮继续使用选中底色，所有黄绿色交互反馈共用同一呼吸渐变。: Other buttons retain selected fills. Accent feedback shares one pulsing gradient.
选中底色、悬停描边和焦点描边共用黄绿色呼吸渐变，所有页面同步变化。: Selected fills, hover outlines and focus outlines share a synchronized yellow-green gradient.
按钮、下拉选项、素材卡片、队列和开关等引用同一颜色源；新进入悬停或选中的控件延续: Buttons, menu choices, cards, queues and switches use the same accent source and current animation phase.
选中使用底色与深色文字，悬停使用描边，实际焦点与选中状态独立；菜单外框和普通容器: Selected items use a fill and dark text. Hover uses a border. Focus is independent and plain containers do not highlight.
关闭界面动效或系统动画后保持静态首色；窗口隐藏、最小化时暂停动画。: Disabling animations uses the first static color. Hidden and minimized windows pause the animation.
选中的选项、素材卡片和队列条目使用黄绿色底色及深色文字。: Selected options, media cards and queue entries use an accent fill with dark text.
悬停改为黄绿色描边，鼠标经过不会改变已有选择。: Hover adds an accent outline without changing selection.
菜单外框、弹窗及普通容器不再作为可选或悬停描边目标，只有具体操作项显示交互反馈。: Only actionable items receive feedback. Menu frames, dialogs and plain containers are excluded.
保留实际键盘焦点、选中和悬停的独立逻辑，以及素材卡片的默认大小。: Keyboard focus, selection and hover stay independent. Default card dimensions are preserved.
悬停、焦点与素材预览修复: Hover, focus and media preview fixes
按钮、下拉选项和菜单等控件悬停时显示浅灰描边，不改变焦点或选中；黄绿色描边跟随实: Hover applies a light-gray outline without changing selection or focus. The accent outline follows keyboard focus.
修复描边停留在其他控件、形状错位和边缘裁切；按住时加粗，拖出或释放后恢复。: Fixed stuck, misaligned and clipped outlines. Pressing thickens the outline until release or drag-out.
应用壁纸期间保留当前按钮的焦点，并阻止重复执行。: Applying a wallpaper keeps button focus and prevents duplicate requests.
素材卡片保持默认大小，信息栏展开或收起时只调整排列；可用空间不足一张卡片时才缩小: Opening details reflows cards at their normal size. They shrink only when one card cannot fit.
悬停、焦点、选中分开：鼠标经过显示中性反馈，黄绿色焦点框始终跟随实际焦点。: Separated hover, focus and selection. Neutral hover feedback leaves the accent frame on the focused control.
确认键直接操作当前焦点控件，移除首次确认仅转交焦点的行为；鼠标经过其他控件不会打: Enter activates the focused control directly. Hovering elsewhere does not interrupt input.
焦点控件按住时描边向外加粗，释放、取消或窗口失活后恢复。: Pressed focus borders thicken outward and reset on release, cancellation or window deactivation.
素材卡片统一用勾选标记表示选中，详情和滚动定位共用当前选中项；保留 Ctrl／S: Media cards show checkmarks. Details and scrolling use the selected item, with Ctrl/Shift multiselect and click-to-clear.
修复 AI 点击、拖动、滚动和键盘输入的原生输入结构。: Fixed native input structures for AI clicks, drags, scrolling and typing.
控件标识随实际控件保持稳定；支持在同一快照中分页读取，操作前校验目标及编辑上下文: Control IDs remain stable. Snapshots support pagination and actions validate their target and editing context.
界面操作失败时提供发送数量和系统错误信息，并清理本次未释放的输入。: Failed actions report input counts and system errors and release pending inputs.
同步修复桌面专注计时器的 AI 按钮点击；操作后仍需读取状态确认结果。: Fixed AI clicks on desktop focus timer controls. Read back the state to confirm the result.
素材库按详情栏展开后的实际宽度排列卡片，小文件大小自动显示 B、KiB 或 Mi: Library columns use the space left by the details pane. Small files display in B, KiB or MiB.
配置分享及素材库相关提示统一使用“素材”。: Unified media terminology in sharing and library notices.
组件编组接口按实际布局顺序返回成员。: Widget group operations return members in layout order.
卸载器退出后清理自身临时副本，并仅移除空安装目录。: The uninstaller removes its temporary copy after exit and deletes only empty install directories.
用户协议和隐私说明使用独立文档修订号，明确适用当前随包测试版。: The user agreement and privacy notice use separate document revision numbers and identify the applicable test build.
修复初始角度与纵向位置相关、相近高度粒子朝向趋同的问题。: Decoupled initial angle from vertical position so nearby particles can face different directions.
主粒子和子粒子的运动设置新增“随机旋转”，默认开启，逐颗随机分配转向和速度。: Main and child particles each get Random rotation, enabled by default, with per-particle direction and speed.
关闭后按设定方向和速度统一旋转；旋转速度为零时保持静止。: Turn it off to use uniform direction and speed. Zero rotation speed holds the particle still.
两层开关独立保存并支持分享与 MCP；旧配置自动启用，指南版本 23。: Both switches save separately and support sharing and MCP. Older configurations default to enabled. Guide version 23.
赭石碎片与安装流程改进: Ochre shard artwork and installer flow
新增透明底的赭石碎片内置外观，去除外围背景、圆盘和右下角角标。: Added a transparent ochre shard without the surrounding background, disc or corner badge.
主粒子、子粒子与随机外观候选均可选择，无需上传图片。: Available for main particles, child particles and random style choices without an upload.
安装时若软件正在运行，可选择“退出程序并安装”，退出后自动继续。: The installer can quit a running app and continue automatically.
保留图片原色，支持既有颜色、发射器和运动设置；配置分享与 MCP 同步，指南版本: Preserves original image colors and uses existing color, emitter and motion settings. Sharing and MCP updated to guide version 22.
修复限帧时画面尚未更新就返回设置已生效的问题。: Fixed premature confirmation of effect changes under frame limiting.
动态效果独立刷新，低帧率视频上的粒子默认以 60 FPS 为目标，并遵守画面帧率: Animated effects refresh independently. Particles target 60 FPS on low-frame-rate video and respect the configured cap.
重复使用视频帧时复用纹理，静态图片调色不再持续重绘。: Repeated video frames reuse textures. Static image color adjustments no longer redraw continuously.
排除透明、半透明及无法确认完全遮挡的分层覆盖窗口，保留普通全屏与最大化暂停。: Excluded transparent or partially covering layered windows from pause detection while retaining ordinary full-screen and maximized rules.
按各屏幕的可见窗口判断暂停，切换前台不再让被覆盖屏幕误恢复。: Uses visible windows on each display. Switching foreground apps no longer resumes a covered display by mistake.
覆盖屏幕工作区的最大化窗口也会暂停壁纸，隐藏任务栏后留下空白区域时同样生效。: Maximized windows covering the work area can pause wallpaper even when hiding the taskbar leaves a gap.
排除最小化、系统隐藏及软件自身窗口；恢复时保留手动、锁屏等其他暂停原因。: Ignores minimized, system-hidden and app-owned windows. Other pause reasons remain active on resume.
两层粒子各自增加颜色开关，默认关闭，关闭后保留图片原色。: Each particle layer has a separate color switch, off by default to preserve source colors.
修复粒子样式、发射器与质量下拉列表空白，保持选中文字显示。: Fixed blank particle style, emitter and quality dropdowns and retained selected text.
颜色开关随配置和分享保存，MCP 参数与指南版本 19 同步。: Color settings save and share with the configuration. MCP guide version 19.
随机粒子与独立子粒子层: Random particles and independent child layers
粒子外观支持勾选多个候选，按粒子随机显示。: Select multiple styles to vary appearance per particle.
内置菲林、原装母带、加密母带、丁尼、齿轮硬币和邦布券六种透明图标。: Added transparent Polychrome, Master Tape, Encrypted Master Tape, Denny, Gear Coin and Boopon icons.
新增独立子粒子层，可分别设置外观、数量、大小、发射器和运动。: Child particles have separate appearance, count, size, emitter and motion controls.
配置保存、分享与 MCP 同步，指南升级至版本 18。: Updated saving, sharing and MCP. Guide version 18.
74 个 MCP 工具按 11 类前缀统一命名，移除旧名称。: Renamed 74 tools with prefixes for 11 categories and removed older names.
新增屏幕设置读取，补齐配置写入版本校验、条件参数验证及统一错误结构。: Added display settings reads, write revision checks, conditional validation and consistent errors.
完善工具输出结构和行为标注，修正时钟创建默认值；指南升级至版本 17。: Improved tool output schemas and behavior annotations and corrected default clock creation. Guide version 17.
补充壁纸取消、素材引用移除、队列编辑、遮罩资源、组件分组与锁定、图片及配置分享操: Added wallpaper removal, media reference removal, queue editing, masks, widget groups and locks, images and sharing operations.
增加配置检查点、保存与重启、截图、渲染和音频观测、受控界面操作与诊断接口。: Added configuration checkpoints, save and restart, screenshots, rendering and audio observation, controlled UI actions and diagnostics.
AI 素材读取需手动授予目录；网址、文件夹和命令快捷卡片均不允许通过 MCP 点: AI media access requires a manually authorized folder. MCP cannot click website, folder or command shortcuts to launch them.
MCP 扩展至 73 个工具，指南版本 16；补充修订检查、重复请求去重和后台任: Expanded MCP to 73 tools, guide version 16. Added revision checks, deduplication and background job query and cancellation.
提高选中素材后自动滚动的响应优先级，详情展开与网格重排后及时定位当前素材。: Prioritized scrolling to the selected item after details open or the grid reflows.
选中定位取消滚动动画，连续切换时以最新选择为准；保留多选、键盘选择和虚拟化定位。: Selection scrolling now jumps to the latest item, including for keyboard selection, multiselect and virtualized cards.
三套时间组件增加 63 项细节设置，分组折叠，保留当前默认外观。: Added 63 settings in collapsible sections for the three clock widgets, with existing appearances as defaults.
支持数字字体、字距、倾斜、阴影、标题和辅助文字、独立配色、品牌栏、斜纹与凹槽调节: Adjust numeral font, spacing, slant, shadows, titles, supporting text, colors, brand strip, stripes and recesses.
时钟开放刻度、表盘数字和指针比例；倒计时开放内容显隐；专注计时器开放进度、圆环和: Configure dial ticks, numerals and hands, countdown fields, and focus timer progress, rings and buttons.
按钮外观与点击区域同步，支持恢复本组或全部细节；配置分享、撤销重做及 MCP 同: Button hit areas follow their appearance. Reset a section or all details. Sharing, undo, redo and MCP are supported. Guide version 15.
粒子发射器与时间组件样式: Particle emitters and clock widget styles
粒子拆分为样式、发射器和运动设置，支持透明图片上传、持续发射与喷发。: Separated appearance, emission and motion. Upload transparent artwork and choose continuous or burst emission.
时钟与日期、倒计时、专注计时器按设计图重做三套外观，补齐品牌栏、凹槽与圆盘层次。: Redesigned the three clock, countdown and focus timer styles with brand strips, recesses and dial details.
雨滴涟漪保留在粒子中；旧配置自动迁移，组件样式可独立选择。: Raindrop ripple stays within particles. Existing settings migrate and widget styles can be selected independently.
大数字使用独立随包字体，修正字重、倾斜、间距和版式比例；新增恢复样式尺寸。同步: Bundled a separate numeral font, refined weight, slant, spacing and proportions, and added Reset style dimensions. MCP guide version 14.
新增时钟与日期、倒计时、专注计时器。: Added clock and date, countdown and focus timer widgets.
新增粒子，支持雪花、樱花、萤火虫、浮尘和火星；雨滴涟漪归入粒子。: Added snow, blossom, firefly, dust and spark particles. Moved raindrop ripple into particles.
解除组件、组件组和快捷卡片的数量限制。: Removed limits on widgets, groups and shortcuts.
沿用现有界面样式、配置分享与撤销重做；MCP 参数同步，指南版本 12。: Uses existing interface styles, sharing and undo. MCP parameters updated in guide version 12.
撤销与重做合并为一个圆角矩形，中间分隔，沿用现有凹槽边框、深色底面与焦点样式。: Combined Undo and Redo into a divided rounded control with the existing recessed styling and focus indicator.
两侧操作保持独立，窄侧栏自动改为上下分段，避免图标和点击区域裁切。: The two actions stay independent and stack on narrow sidebars to avoid clipping.
移除手柄输入支持及设置入口，首版继续使用键鼠操作。: Removed controller input and its settings. The initial release uses the keyboard and mouse.
撤销／重做与快捷键保留；MCP 能力和说明同步，29 个工具、指南版本 11。: Undo, redo and their shortcuts remain available. MCP includes 29 tools in guide version 11.
修复素材库点击空白后勾选框残留，选择与对勾同步清除。: Fixed stale checkmarks after clearing library selection by clicking empty space.
AI 操作移除高级连接方式，保留开关和复制连接提示词。: Simplified AI settings to an enable switch and copyable connection instructions.
新增撤销／重做按钮及快捷键，支持画面效果、组件、播放队列配置和素材引用移除。: Added Undo and Redo buttons and shortcuts for effects, widgets, queues and removing library references.
新增手柄焦点导航、确认返回、多选、滚动及数值调整，设置可关闭或查看按键映射。: Added controller navigation, confirm/back, multiselect, scrolling and value changes, with settings and a button map.
手柄不使用虚拟鼠标和屏幕键盘，仅软件与所属对话框处于前台时响应。: Controller input works only while the app or its dialogs are in front and does not use a virtual pointer or on-screen keyboard.
MCP 增加通用撤销与重做，共 29 个工具，指南版本 10。: Added general undo and redo to MCP for 29 tools. Guide version 10.
普通点击素材卡片转移单选，右上角勾选框可逐项增减多选。: Click a card to select one item. Use corner checkboxes to add or remove individual selections.
支持 Ctrl 点选和 Shift 连续范围选择，点击空白取消选择。: Use Ctrl-click or Shift-click to select multiple items. Click empty space to clear.
详情展开和网格重排后定位当前操作的素材，单选和多选保持可见。: After details expand or cards reflow, the active item stays visible in single and multiple selections.
右键菜单将添加素材后移，合并重复的画面效果与屏幕设置入口。: Moved Add media lower in the context menu and merged duplicate effects and display settings entries.
桌面和托盘的打开控制中心统一进入首页，MCP 指南与安装包同步更新。: Opening the control center from the desktop or tray opens Home. Updated the MCP guide and installer.
解码测试改为软硬解对比卡片，新增 GPU、内存和专用／共享显存数据。: Software and hardware results appear side by side with GPU, RAM and dedicated and shared GPU memory data.
移除解码与封面界面的说明段落，耗时等详细数据默认折叠。: Removed redundant decoder and cover instructions. Detailed timings start collapsed.
修复素材库选择封面帧、解码性能测试按钮的文字裁切。: Fixed clipped cover and decoder test button labels in the library.
画面效果默认作用于显示器，只通过作用对象选择器切换，素材选择和页面导航不再改动它: Effects target the display by default. Only the target picker changes this selection.
性能监控总览和进程列表新增 GPU、专用／共享显存，支持按 GPU 或显存排序。: Added GPU and dedicated/shared GPU memory to performance and process views with sorting by GPU or memory.
显示器和视频分别保存并显示各自效果，播放时仍合成，视频覆盖同名效果。: Display and media effects save and display separately. Playback combines them with media taking precedence for matching effects.
MCP 同步资源指标与分层效果，指南与安装包更新至 0.1.9.1。: MCP includes the new metrics and layered effects. Guide and installer version 0.1.9.1.
设置新增自动、优先硬件和软件解码，可对比软硬解性能并采用建议。: Choose automatic, hardware-preferred or software decoding. Compare decoders and apply the recommended method.
帧率限制提前选择画面，减少不必要的回读与转色；改善有声播放持续落后时的同步恢复。: Frame limiting selects frames earlier to reduce readback and color conversion. Improved audio sync recovery during sustained lag.
自动封面同时参考亮度、清晰度和邻近画面，减少运动模糊。: Automatic covers consider brightness, sharpness and nearby frames to reduce motion blur.
素材库支持时间轴、秒数定位、逐帧调整和静音预览，手动封面保留，也可恢复自动选图。: Choose covers by timeline, seconds or frame stepping with muted preview. Keep a manual frame or revert to automatic.
MCP 同步新增解码和封面操作，沿用当前界面样式。: Added decoder and cover operations to MCP using the existing interface style.
音频效果、参数、频段与响应使用固定选项和普通纵向列表，修正弹窗列表空白。: Effect, parameter, band and response dropdowns use fixed options and vertical lists, fixing empty popups.
框内已选文字独立显示，展开或未选择便收起时保持原有选项。: The selected label remains visible even when the dropdown is dismissed without a choice.
仅切换效果时刷新参数列表，MCP 与安装包同步完整版本号 0.1.8.1。: Refresh parameters only when the effect changes. MCP and installer report version 0.1.8.1.
新配置默认准备好经典联动，自定义规则从空白开始。: New configurations include classic response settings and start with no custom rules.
按需选择效果与参数，只显示已添加的联动分组。: Choose effects and parameters on demand. Only added mappings appear.
修复添加自定义联动时下拉选项空白，频段与响应选择同步修正。: Fixed empty dropdown options when adding mappings, including band and response choices.
